card.essence: A remedy primarily for mucous membrane affections with marked gastric symptoms producing a catarrhal stomach condition. Characterised by peculiar cravings, profound chilliness, and debility—especially in women with uterine displacement due to defective nutrition. The patient is faint, wants to lie down constantly, with cold clammy skin and laboured respiration.
card.sides: Right-sided (right shoulder-blade pain, right lung feels small)

keynotes.text: Canine hunger with craving for meat, pickles, radishes, coarse food—eats beyond digestive capacity
Cold shivering as if blood were ice-water; chills run down back
Wants to lie down all the time; profound prostration with cold, clammy skin
Uterine displacement with sore fundus relieved by pressure; thinks womb is soft and feeble
Flatulence disturbs heart action; respiration and heart action laboured

physicals: Gnawing, hungry, faint feeling at epigastrium
Burning and distention of stomach and abdomen with palpitation
Pain in right shoulder-blade with constipation and burning in rectum
Right lung and liver feel small and hard
Hands cold, skin clammy and sticky
clinical: Catarrhal gastritis with ravenous appetite and peculiar food cravings
Uterine displacements with debility in women
Dyspepsia with flatulence affecting cardiac function
